say:1:1721442001:0.text: And give Amy her money back! That's all she has!
say:1:1721442001:0.source_cn: 骗子，把钱还给艾米！那是她的全部财产！

say:2:1721442002:0.text: And that robe of yours... You stole it, didn't you? Take it off!
say:2:1721442002:0.source_cn: 还有这件魔法师的袍子，也是你偷来的吧？脱下来！

say:3:1721442003:0.text: Please, stop... I was wrong! Here—take all the money back!
say:3:1721442003:0.source_cn: 别打了……我错了，我错了！我把钱全还给你们还不行吗！

say:4:1721442004:0.source_cn: 另外，向艾米道歉，承认你骗了她！

say:7:1721442006:0.text: Amy, you don't have to apologize! This isn't your fault! He's the one to blame!
say:7:1721442006:0.source_cn: 艾米，你不需要道歉！我们都知道这不是你的错，要怪就怪这...

say:8:1721442007:0.text: No, I'm a liar, too... I've been fooling myself all along...
say:8:1721442007:0.source_cn: 不、不……我也是骗子……我一直都在骗自己……

say:9:1721442008:0.text: I knew Prince Orion wasn't around anymore...
say:9:1721442008:0.source_cn: 其实我早就知道……奥利安殿下不可能在……

say:11:1721442010:0.text: There's no more purpose in my life...
say:11:1721442010:0.source_cn: 那我……我还有什么……还有什么活下去的理由……

say:13:1721442012:0.text: My mother's gone, and my father abandoned me... Now, even Prince Orion is... I've lost my last hope...
say:13:1721442012:0.source_cn: 母亲不在了，父亲抛弃了我……家族也没了……现在连奥利安...

say:15:1721442014:0.text: No... The moment I moved out of the upper district, we were no longer from the same world. It's only a matter of time...
say:15:1721442014:0.source_cn: 不，在我搬出上城区的时候，我们就不是一个世界的人了。迟...

say:18:1721442016:1.text: Prince Orion gave it to me...
say:18:1721442016:1.source_cn: 是奥利安殿下送给我的那张手帕……它……没有丢……

say:19:1721442017:0.text: Yes, and he gave it to you because he cared about you.
say:19:1721442017:0.source_cn: 没错，殿下送你这块手帕，是因为他关心你。

say:20:1721442018:1.text: What would he think if he saw you like this?
say:20:1721442018:1.source_cn: 如果看到你这个样子，他会怎么想？

say:21:1721442019:0.text: Prince Orion would surely want you to be well. If you hope to see him again someday, you need to take care of yourself.
say:21:1721442019:0.source_cn: 殿下也一定希望你好好活着。只有你好好照顾自己，才有可能...

say:23:1721442021:0.text: The young lady before you is little more than skin and bones, her clothes hanging slack on her frame. Her face is pale and sallow, and her eyes are hollow.
say:23:1721442021:0.source_cn: 你看着眼前的少女。她瘦得几乎只剩骨架，一身衣服空荡荡地...
say:23:1721442021:0.male: The young lady before you is little more than skin and bones, her clothes hanging slack on her frame. Her face is pale and sallow, and her eyes are hollow.
say:23:1721442021:0.female: The young lady before you is little more than skin and bones, her clothes hanging slack on her frame. Her face is pale and sallow, and her eyes are hollow.

say:24:1721442022:0.text: Just tell her a white lie. After all, Prince Orion has told you plenty of lies himself.
say:24:1721442022:0.source_cn: 关于奥利安的事，对她说个善意的谎吧。毕竟奥利安本人也骗...
say:24:1721442022:0.male: Just tell her a white lie. After all, Prince Orion has told you plenty of lies himself.
say:24:1721442022:0.female: Just tell her a white lie. After all, Prince Orion has told you plenty of lies himself.

choice_prompt:25:1721442022.male: Just tell her a white lie. After all, Prince Orion has told you plenty of lies himself.
choice_prompt:25:1721442022.female: Just tell her a white lie. After all, Prince Orion has told you plenty of lies himself.

say:27:1721442024:0.text: Absolutely. This is the real Magister Merlin, mind you.
say:27:1721442024:0.source_cn: 当然，这可是真正的梅林阁下说的。
say:27:1721442024:0.male: Absolutely. This is the real Magister Merlin, mind you.
say:27:1721442024:0.female: Absolutely. This is the real Magister Merlin, mind you.

say:30:1721442027:0.text: I know what to do now... Thank you, all of you.
say:30:1721442027:0.source_cn: 我……我明白了……谢谢你们，夏洛洛、希琳娜……梅林阁下……
say:30:1721442027:0.male: I know what to do now... Thank you, all of you.
say:30:1721442027:0.female: I know what to do now... Thank you, all of you.

say:32:1721442028:0.text: Dura above, Amy finally came around. We can't thank you enough.
say:32:1721442028:0.source_cn: 艾雅在上，艾米终于把我们的话听进去了。这都多亏了您，梅...
say:32:1721442028:0.male: Dura above, Amy finally came around. We can't thank you enough.
say:32:1721442028:0.female: Dura above, Amy finally came around. We can't thank you enough.

say:33:1721442029:0.text: Not only did you forgive our rudeness, but you also went out of your way to help our friend...
say:33:1721442029:0.source_cn: 真的非常感谢您，不仅没有计较我们对您的冒犯，还救下了艾米……
say:33:1721442029:0.male: Not only did you forgive our rudeness, but you also went out of your way to help our friend...
say:33:1721442029:0.female: Not only did you forgive our rudeness, but you also went out of your way to help our friend...

say:34:1721442030:0.source_cn: 您不愧是耀光最厉害的大魔法师！

narration:35:1721442031:0.text: With the matter finally settled, you wave goodbye to the girls.
narration:35:1721442031:0.source_cn: 事情终于结束，你挥手向少女们告别
narration:35:1721442031:0.male: With the matter finally settled, you wave goodbye to the girls.
narration:35:1721442031:0.female: With the matter finally settled, you wave goodbye to the girls.

choice:25:1:2.female: You wouldn't want to let him down, would you?
